title: Germy
description: My first ever app—a Pandemic-era Tetris inspired experiment.
longDescription: Started in 2020, Germy was the project where I taught myself Flutter. Originally a pandemic-themed game, it faced multiple App Store rejections due to sensitivity policies and gameplay similarities. Despite not hitting Apple's store, it reached the Play Store and serves as the technical foundation for everything I build today.

title: APEify
description: My first major success story. An avatar creator that grew to 70k+ organic downloads through viral social trends.
longDescription: APEify is a character tracking and progression app that allows users to manage their character data, save progress via Firebase, and interact with a premium UI. It remains one of the core active projects in the ecosystem.

title: Ten Beer Plan
description: My first custom backend journey—a social coordination MVP born from a meme.
longDescription: Ten Beer Plan was a technical milestone where I built my first personal backend using Python, Flask, and SQLAlchemy. It was an MVP tested by a small group of users, but ultimately hit a roadblock with Apple's sensitivity policies regarding alcohol content. It served as a massive learning experience for authentication, database management, and AWS deployment.

title: House Price Alerts
description: Real-time alerts for property market shifts.
longDescription: Technically complete but strategically paused. Following the 'User-First' philosophy of Project Northstar, this app's release is pending proven user demand to ensure the development effort matches market interest.
